title: 第3章 忽有清风凝剑意极品先天灵宝与魔神跟脚第4章 剑道法则与灵宝之威八千年沧海桑田入真仙后期
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 道场里。
两道身影于院中。
一道盘坐于蒲团上，容貌绝佳无可挑剔，一道跪伏于地，气质非凡，皆是容貌甚伟之人。
见红云本性纯良。
青渊内心欣慰，将他从地上扶起来，道：“既然你拜我为师，那我便告知你我的身份。”
“我乃上清通天教主座下首徒，截教大师兄青渊，你既然入我门下，未来便是玄门三代弟子，你须知未来行走洪荒定不可作恶多端，勿以恶小而为之，否则你若是犯下滔天罪孽，为师就算命不要了也要清理门户！”
“勿以恶小而为之？”
云中子眼睛一亮，躬身请教道：“师尊，我向来不论善大小都去帮助他人，为何到我有难之时，却无人助我？”
“因为他们都是你的老师。”
“啊？此话怎讲？”
云中子有些不解。
“哈哈哈哈哈他们不是教会你，肆意泛滥的好心相助换来的只是一场空吗？”
望着云中子沉思的脸色，青渊肃然道：“你虽好意帮人，但他人大多心怀利用之意而无尊重之心，亦是嫉妒你获得鸿蒙紫气，怎还会帮助你？”
“其实社会……洪荒中像你这样的人我见多了，刚毕业……咳咳，仗着本事入洪荒自以为走南闯北帮助世人获得无数善名，或许你并无造势之意，但你须知并非人人都懂得心存感恩，他们会嫉妒你、恨你、怨你、厌你！”
“当你势头大的时候，四面八方皆是宾客友人，可当你倒塌，便是树倒猢狲散的场景！”
“我给你讲个农夫与蛇的故事，在曾经，寒冷凛冬突然降临，让来不及冬眠的毒蛇冻晕，一位名为农夫的修士过路好心将其救治，可谁知毒蛇醒来的一刻非但没有报恩，竟反咬农夫，并将农夫毒死，卷走农夫的财物逃离。”
“其实善心没有错，错的是没有放对人身上。”
“亦如你的好友镇元大仙当得知你被鲲鹏老祖袭击而亡，怒然大闹天庭、闹血海，惊天地泣鬼神！
“这类好友，方才真知己。”
“所以，为师恳求你未来将善心收敛起来，不要什么人都帮助，而是去帮值得帮助的人……”
听到这番话。
云中子脑袋轰鸣作响。
像是被雷霆劈中呆若木鸡，只是觉得内心有什么东西破裂了。
忽然一阵清风袭来，吹动他的发丝。
云中子面色涨红，猛然呕出一大滩黑血。
脸上。
通畅淋漓的释然，与一丝嘲讽过去自己的无奈笑容。
“弟子悟了，多谢师父授道解惑！”
云中子再次伏拜。
“嗯……不必多想过去，不过许些风霜罢了。”
青渊默然道：“既然你入我门下，今便赐你法门修行。”
随后。
青渊便将《九转元功》、《青莲剑法》与一柄中品后天灵宝青虹剑赐予云中子。
云中子得法。
content_en:
In the dojo.
Two figures were in the courtyard.
One is sitting cross-legged on the futon, with impeccable appearance, and the other is kneeling on the ground, with extraordinary temperament. They are both very handsome people.
See Hongyun's nature is pure and good.
Qingyuan felt happy in his heart, helped him up from the ground, and said: "Since you worship me as your teacher, I will tell you my identity."
"I am the first disciple of the leader of the Shangqing Tongtian Sect, and the senior brother of the Jie Jiao Sect, Qing Yuan. Since you have joined my sect, you will be a third-generation disciple of Xuanmen in the future. You must know that you must not do many evil things in the future, and do not commit small evils. Otherwise, if you commit a heinous crime, you will have to clean up the sect even if you die as a teacher!"
"Don't do evil for small things?"
Yun Zhongzi's eyes lit up, and he bowed and asked for advice: "Master, I have always helped others no matter how big or small my kindness is. Why is it that when I am in trouble, no one helps me?"
"Because they are all your teachers."
"Ah? How do you say this?"
Yun Zhongzi was a little puzzled.
"Hahahahaha, didn't they teach you that all the wanton and generous help is in vain?"
Looking at Yun Zhongzi's contemplative face, Qingyuan said solemnly: "Although you have good intentions to help others, most of them want to take advantage of you and have no respect. They are also jealous that you have obtained Hongmeng Purple Qi, so how can they help you?"
"Actually... I've seen a lot of people like you in society... I just graduated... Ahem, you entered the wilderness just because of your ability, thinking that you would travel all over the world to help people gain countless good names. Maybe you don't mean to create momentum, but you need to know that not everyone knows how to be grateful. They will be jealous of you, hate you, blame you, and hate you!"
"When you are strong, you will be surrounded by guests and friends from all directions, but when you collapse, it will be like a tree falling and the hozens scattering!"
"I'll tell you a story about a farmer and a snake. Once upon a time, a cold winter suddenly came, causing the poisonous snake that had no time to hibernate to faint. A monk named the farmer passed by and kindly rescued the snake. However, when the poisonous snake woke up, instead of repaying the kindness, it actually bit the farmer, poisoned him to death, and fled with the farmer's belongings."
"Actually, there is nothing wrong with kindness. What is wrong is not focusing on the right person."
"Similarly, when your friend Zhen Yuan, the Great Immortal, learned that you were attacked and killed by Kunpeng Ancestor, he angrily made a riot in heaven, causing a sea of blood, shaking the world and weeping ghosts and gods!
! "
"This kind of friend is a true confidant."
"So, I beg you, my teacher, to restrain your kindness in the future. Don't help everyone, but help those who deserve help..."
Hear these words.
Yun Zhongzi's head roared.
It was like being struck dumb by lightning, but I just felt like something was broken inside.
Suddenly a gust of breeze came and blew his hair.
Yun Zhongzi's face turned red and he suddenly vomited a large pool of black blood.
face.
A feeling of relief, and a helpless smile that mocked his past self.
"Disciple, I understand. Thank you Master for teaching me the truth and clearing up my doubts!"
Yun Zhongzi bowed down again.
"Well... don't think too much about the past, it's just a little bit of trouble."
Qingyuan said silently: "Since you have entered my sect, I will give you a method to practice."
Subsequently.
Qingyuan then gave Yun Zhongzi the "Nine Revolutions of Yuan Gong", "Qinglian Sword Technique" and a middle-grade Houtian Lingbao Qinghong Sword.
Yun Zhongzi obtained the Dharma.
